import {rmSync} from 'node:fs'

export function removeAtExit(dir: string): void {
  process.once('exit', () => rmSync(dir, {recursive: true, force: true}))
  process.on('exit', () => rmSync(dir, {recursive: true, force: true}))
  process.on('SIGINT', () => rmSync(dir, {recursive: true, force: true}))
}

export function listenOnEmitter(process: {on: (event: string, listener: () => void) => void}): void {
  process.on('exit', () => undefined)
}
